name: pippa
tagline: A bite of the bright side.
description: A candy-bright identity for a small bakery. A playful bow, pink blocks, and sunny yellow surprises make every box feel like a present before it is even opened.
heading: rubik
rules: Bow loops stay full and symmetrical while the tails may crop.
Use jam for nutritional details and all small text.
Treat product names as big, cheerful headlines rather than labels.

system.concept: Folded ribbons, sculptural pastry-like swirls, pink gift boxes, and exuberant heavy type. Every useful label is part of a generous little celebration.
headline: A little sweeter.
A little brighter.
features: Good ingredients and plenty of attention to the small things.
A simple pleasure that feels like a small present.
Sweet things for sharing, celebrating, or just because.
system.layoutNote: Candy-pink centered hero with a ribbon pastry image, jam headings, lemon-pill buttons, and softly rounded bakery tiles. Practical ingredients stay plain and legible.
